protocol.execution: existing Decimal engine; next-open, SL-first ambiguity, adverse stop gaps, capped TP gaps, max1, forced final close; trailing optional only A; no risk formula changes

A.exit: opposite prior20 channel; ratcheting3ATR14 trailing armed next candle, clamp to current close; never intrabar retroactive

B.entry: EMA50/200 alignment + price EMA50 + ADX14>=25 rising eligibility edge;64 candle global signal cooldown
B.exit: EMA reversal/price loses EMA50 or ADX<20

C.entry: prior8 candles contain20-bar Bollinger width below0.5 times past120 width median; close breaks prior20 channel;32 signal cooldown

D.entry: RSI14 returns above30/below70; ADX14<=20 and abs(EMA50-EMA200)/ATR14<=1

E.entry: EMA20/50 alignment agrees on15m and last COMPLETE1h/4h;15m price EMA20; eligibility rising edge;64 signal cooldown
E.exit: any timeframe alignment lost or15m price loses EMA20

protocol.limits: 72 monthly ZIP/checksum pairs <=8MiB compressed/16MiB CSV each;<=211000 candles; no full long-history curves in artifacts; daily curve/complete ledger; bounded offline CPU default240s cap900s
protocol.network: single8s official2020-01 checksum ConnectError; no archives downloaded
protocol.no_selection: All fixed before new results; no optimization, no activation; retrospective prior-viewed2026 not independent proof
protocol.regimes: signal-close ADX14>=25 TREND <=20 RANGE else TRANSITION; ATR14/close >= median of prior500 normalized ATR HIGH otherwise LOW; insufficient history UNKNOWN
